jobs.title: Databricks Data Engineer
jobs.description: Join Deloitte's Core AI & Data practice and help organizations modernize data platforms, strengthen enterprise data foundations, and scale analytics and artificial intelligence capabilities. As a Databricks Data Engineer, you will support the design, build, and optimization of cloud-based data engineering solutions that enable large-scale transformation. You will work with business and technology teams to modernize data environments, support analytics and artificial intelligence use cases, and deliver measurable business outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to help clients implement enterprise-scale Databricks solutions that improve platform performance and expand data-driven decision-making. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026. Work you'll do As a Data Engineer II on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and data engineering solutions using Databricks, Apache Spark, Python, and Structured Query Language (SQL) Support the modernization of enterprise data platforms by implementing cloud-based ingestion, transformation, and storage patterns Develop and maintain batch and streaming data workflows that support reporting, analytics, and artificial intelligence use cases Apply data architecture, integration, and data modeling practices to improve data quality, scalability, and platform performance Collaborate with client and Deloitte teams to troubleshoot issues, implement enhancements, and support delivery of large-scale data transformation programs A successful candidate would possess these skills: Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to provide clear guidance to others The team Deloitte's Core AI & Data practice helps organizations modernize data platforms, strengthen enterprise data foundations, and scale analytics and artificial intelligence capabilities across the business. The team works with clients to architect, engineer, and deploy cloud-based data solutions that improve decision-making, enable innovation, and support large-scale transformation. Practitioners collaborate across business and technology functions to solve complex challenges in data modernization, governance, platform engineering, and insight delivery. Qualifications Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Mathematics, or Statistics 3+ years of experience in data engineering, extract, transform, load (ETL) development, or data platform engineering 2+ years of experience building data pipelines in Databricks using Apache Spark, Python, and Structured Query Language (SQL) Experience implementing data models, data integration patterns, and cloud-based data processing workflows Experience working with at least one cloud platform: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. Preferred: Experience with Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows, and Unity Catalog Experience using Git-based version control and continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines Experience supporting batch and streaming data workloads Experience with data warehousing, lakehouse architecture, and performance optimization Experience supporting analytics or machine learning data pipelines Experience working in consulting or client service delivery environments The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $86,700 to $170,900. Information for applicants with a need for accommodation: https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/careers/articles/join-deloitte-assistance-for-disabled-applic...

jobs.title: AI Data Engineer
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Data Engineer based in the United States. As an AI Data Engineer, you will build and optimize the data infrastructure that powers intelligent products and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable data pipelines, develop automated data preparation workflows, and implement synthetic data generation solutions to support evolving AI workloads. Your responsibilities will include data modeling, storage architecture, retrieval systems, and automated validation to ensure data reliability and accessibility. Working closely with product and engineering teams, you will help transform complex data into high-quality resources that enable effective AI development and deployment. This opportunity combines modern data engineering practices with the challenges of building dependable infrastructure for next-generation AI applications. It is ideal for a technically driven professional who enjoys solving complex problems and developing scalable, high-performance data solutions in a remote, project-based environment. Accountabilities AI Data Pipeline Development: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that support AI workloads, intelligent products, and data-intensive applications. Synthetic Data Generation: Develop and maintain automated workflows for generating synthetic data to support AI development, testing, validation, and product improvement. Data Preparation & Processing: Build reliable processes for collecting, transforming, structuring, and preparing large-scale datasets for use in AI-enabled applications. Data Modeling & Architecture: Design data models and storage solutions that support efficient data organization, scalability, accessibility, and long-term maintainability. Data Validation & Quality Assurance: Implement automated validation processes, quality controls, and monitoring mechanisms to ensure data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and reliability. Storage & Retrieval Systems: Develop and optimize backend data systems and retrieval mechanisms that enable efficient access to relevant information for AI applications and intelligent products. Scalable Backend Engineering: Build and maintain robust data infrastructure capable of handling large datasets, evolving workloads, and changing application requirements. AI Product Integration: Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, and AI development teams to align data infrastructure with application requirements and product objectives. Workflow Automation: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive data engineering tasks, improve processing efficiency, and reduce manual intervention across data workflows. Performance Optimization & Troubleshooting: Investigate data pipeline failures, storage limitations, and retrieval bottlenecks, implementing improvements that strengthen system performance and reliability. Continuous Improvement: Evaluate data engineering practices and emerging approaches to improve scalability, maintainability, and the effectiveness of AI data infrastructure. Requirements AI Data Engineering Experience: Practical experience designing, developing, or maintaining scalable data pipelines for AI workloads, intelligent products, or other data-intensive applications. Python Proficiency: Strong programming skills in Python for data processing, workflow automation, pipeline development, and backend data engineering. Data Generation & Preparation: Experience developing automated data generation, data transformation, or data preparation workflows to support complex application requirements. Data Modeling & Storage: Demonstrated ability to design data models and storage solutions for large-scale datasets, with an understanding of scalability, performance, and efficient data access. Data Validation & Quality Controls: Experience implementing automated validation, data quality checks, and monitoring processes to maintain reliable and consistent datasets. Backend Data Systems: Ability to develop dependable backend data infrastructure and retrieval mechanisms that support AI-enabled products and applications. Scalability & Performance: Understanding of scalable data architecture, efficient processing techniques, and approaches to optimizing data workflows and system performance. AI Application Integration: Experience collaborating with product or engineering teams to support the data requirements of AI-driven applications and intelligent products. Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical thinking and troubleshooting abilities, with a proactive approach to resolving technical challenges and improving data reliability. Communication & Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams, translate product needs into technical solutions, and communicate complex engineering concepts clearly. Preferred Experience: Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Copilot or similar enterprise AI products is an advantage. Remote Work Readiness: Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage priorities effectively, and contribute to contract-based project delivery. Employment Conditions: This is a contract opportunity based remotely in the United States. Applicants should be prepared to provide their current location, work authorization details, desired hourly rate, and current contract end date during the application process. Benefits Competitive Hourly Rate: Indicative compensation ranging from $67 to $77 per hour, depending on relevant experience, technical expertise, and project requirements. Remote Work Flexibility: Work remotely from within the United States. Contract-Based Engagement: Gain hands-on experience contributing to AI and data engineering projects in a project-oriented environment. Exposure to AI Innovation: Work on data infrastructure and workflows that support intelligent products and next-generation AI applications. Modern Engineering Challenges: Develop expertise in scalable data pipelines, synthetic data generation, automated validation, data modeling, and retrieval systems. Technical Growth: Strengthen your data engineering and backend development skills while working on complex, large-scale data challenges. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering teams to deliver reliable data solutions aligned with real-world AI application needs. Impactful Work: Help build the foundational data systems that enable intelligent products to operate effectively and reliably. Employment Type: Contract. Experience Level: Entry-level listing, with practical experience in scalable data engineering and AI-related data workflows required. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? jobs.title: Data Engineer II
jobs.description: Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey. This role is hands-on and delivery-oriented: you will design, build, and implement reusable analytics products and assets that meet client needs and extend our Human Capital service offerings. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026. Work you'll do The Data Engineer Consultant will support data architecture and engineering delivery that enables artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and generative AI (GenAI) solutions, ensuring data is trusted, secure, observable, and scalable from ingestion through consumption. You will design and operationalize modern data and retrieval foundations to support large language model (LLM)-powered applications (e.g., Claude, GPT/Codex, Gemini) including patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and governed access to structured and unstructured data and work directly with Human Capital product managers and clients to design and deliver data-driven workforce and human capital analytics solutions, owning end-to-end solutions from data modeling to stakeholder presentations. You will build dashboards, reports, and reusable analytics products, turning complex human capital data into clear, actionable insights. You will be part of a blended onshore/offshore delivery team, partnering with data science, ML engineering, and product stakeholders to translate use cases into production-ready pipelines and platforms with strong data governance, lineage, quality controls, and monitoring. Lead the design, development, and delivery of analytics solutions that address complex workforce and human capital challenges for clients across industries. Build and maintain scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting frameworks using Structured Query Language (SQL) and Tableau (or equivalent visualization platforms). Translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical approaches, communicating findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaborate across service lines to embed AI-enabled capabilities and emerging data methodologies into client solutions. Support business development efforts including proposals, client presentations, and thought leadership content. Design and deliver intuitive, executive-ready reports and dashboards that make complex workforce data accessible and actionable. A successful candidate would possess these skills: Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to provide clear guidance to others The team HC Forward is a dedicated innovation partner accelerating the future of Human Capital by building market-aligned products, platforms, and services that apply AI, data, and engineering to modernize HR experiences and outcomes. Qualifications Required: Bachelor's degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science) 2+ years of experience in data science, data engineering, or analytics. 2+ years of modern data & AI engineering, including data modeling, batch/streaming pipelines, structured/unstructured processing, and feature engineering/serving fundamentals. 1+ years of experience with machine learning concepts, large language model applications, or AI-augmented analytics workflows. 2+ years of experience using Python or R for statistical modeling and data wrangling, including proficiency in Databricks or Snowflake. Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: Advanced degree, including a Master of Science (MS) or Doctor of Philosophy (PhD), and/or relevant certifications. Direct experience in client-facing or consulting environments, with Human Capital platforms and integrations (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle Human Capital Management (HCM), Salesforce), or in Human Resources (HR) data domains. Experience operationalizing large language model operations (LLMOps) and machine learning operations (MLOps) capabilities, including evaluation, monitoring, governance workflows, and model/prompt/version management. Cloud experience on one or more of Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including managed data platforms and scalable compute patterns. Experience explaining complex data and technology concepts, articulating risks and trade-offs, documenting decisions, and collaborating across product, data science/ML, data engineering, platform, and security teams. Experience in analytics product development-building repeatable tools, models, or platforms rather than one-off deliverables-and ethics and privacy practices, including recognizing consent, personally identifiable information (PII), and bias boundaries and escalating appropriately. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $91,100 to $179,500. jobs.title: Associate, Data Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. Position Overview The Insurance Data Science team reports through the Chief Risk Officer and uses AI and machine learning techniques to develop predictive models for policy-level transactions and human behavior. The models are used to develop and price retail products and institutional reinsurance deals, monitor related risk, and assist in forecasting and financial reporting. The group has a unique vantage point in nearly all aspects of the enterprise and is actively enhancing its capacity, continuing to grow with the whole company. The successful candidate will have an opportunity to work on a variety of projects depending on skill set, interest, and personal goals, and to collaborate with other teams with functions mentioned above. The team is heavily invested in developing agentic AI tools to solve company-wide problems and boost efficiency of all aspects of work. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance. Base Salary Range $145,000—$165,000 USD KKR is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Data Science Analyst - Agentic AI Developer
jobs.description: Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re all about propelling the next generation of leaders forward. We are driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future. We deliver innovative solutions that make our customers’ lives easier—helping them power, protect, and intelligently manage their homes and businesses. To do this, we need creative and talented people to join our company. We offer a dynamic work environment and a unified and inclusive culture. NRG fosters a strong sense of belonging that leads to better collaboration and business performance. Our company programs are designed to help employees develop the skills they need for success now and in the future. In everything we do, we aim to champion our employees and bring value to our customers, investors and society. More information is available at www.nrg.com. Connect with NRG on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and X. Job Summary NRG Energy is seeking a Data Science Analyst – Agentic AI Developer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions that improve decision-making, automate business processes, and generate actionable insights across the organization. This role combines data science, machine learning, software engineering, and agentic AI development to solve complex business challenges in the energy industry. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the full AI lifecycle—from data acquisition and model development to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement—and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. Essential Duties/Responsibilities Collect, clean, integrate, and preprocess large structured and unstructured datasets to support advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI applications. Design, develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning models for forecasting, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, recommendation systems, classification, and operational optimization. Build AI-powered applications using large language models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, APIs, and workflow automation to improve productivity and streamline business processes. Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy scalable AI solutions, translating ambiguous business challenges into practical, production-ready applications. Develop scalable data pipelines, reusable software components, APIs, and AI workflows that integrate enterprise data sources and operational systems. Collaborate with business stakeholders, software engineers, data engineers, analysts, and subject matter experts to integrate AI capabilities into business workflows. Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, generate actionable insights, and communicate findings through dashboards, reports, and data visualizations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve AI models and applications to ensure accuracy, scalability, reliability, governance, and responsible AI practices. Stay current with emerging AI, machine learning, and data science technologies, evaluating opportunities to drive innovation and business value. Working Conditions Fully in-office position based in Houston, TX or Princeton, NJ, with flexibility to work outside normal business hours as needed to support critical business operations and project milestones. Minimum Requirements Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Quantitative Finance, or a related quantitative discipline, completed or expected to be completed by December 2026; Master’s degree preferred. Zero or more years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, AI application development, or advanced analytics. Preferred Qualifications Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or similar orchestration frameworks; NLP, Generative AI, Computer Vision, Spark, Databricks, MLflow, Kubernetes, time-series forecasting, energy markets, or cloud-native AI services (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) is highly desirable Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience processing large datasets and developing production-quality software. Experience with machine learning frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, or similar technologies. Experience developing AI applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agent frameworks, vector databases, REST APIs, and modern software development tools (Git, Docker). Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, or Matplotlib), and building scalable data pipelines. Strong understanding of statistics, feature engineering, model evaluation, and MLOps fundamentals. Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities, collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, and deliver high-quality AI solutions with professionalism, integrity, and a commitment to continuous learning.
